en: A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a rural inn or guesthouse named "Gasthof zum Heilbrunnen" in a countryside setting. The main building is a white, multi-story house partly obscured by large trees, with an attached lower structure extending to the right. In the foreground there is a field or meadow, and in the background a soft pastel evening or morning sky. Printed German text appears along the bottom margin and on the facade of the building.
